clips.title: The story
paras: Camping 101: Cooking introduces adventurers to the essential craft of survival in the wilderness. By directing travelers to Cook Torka in Razor Hill, it teaches the fundamentals of cooking and campfire creation necessary to establish personal campsites in the wild.

For any wanderer setting foot beyond settlement gates, surviving the wilderness requires more than sharp steel and sturdy armor. The quest Camping 101: Cooking directs budding adventurers to Cook Torka in Razor Hill to learn the culinary arts. In the open wastes of Durotar and beyond, cooking represents far more than preparing a hot meal—it is the foundational discipline required to light a reliable campfire, which serves as the heart of any campsite.

Mastering the basics allows travelers to pitch a modest camp nearly anywhere across the frontier. While a novice campfire supports only a handful of essential furnishings, further dedication to the craft opens new possibilities. Deepening one's cooking expertise allows the construction of larger blazes, while pursuing other trade skills provides the craftsmanship needed to furnish and enhance camps into reliable bastions against the untamed wild.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, adventurer. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.
Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

clips.title: Completion
paras: With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.
Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.
You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
